zh.title: 沙特吉赞：炼厂遇袭后部分业务暂停
zh.summary: 沙特能源部确认吉赞炼厂发生致命袭击，部分业务暂停，正在评估损失。
zh.body: 路透社11月26日援引沙特能源部声明称，吉赞炼厂遇袭后发生火灾，一名尼泊尔员工死亡，部分业务暂时停止。沙特领导的联军将事件归责于胡塞武装。分析：连续能源设施事件使企业面临人员安全与供应履约的双重压力。实际供应影响取决于停运范围及恢复周期。采购部门应向供应商确认交付安排，现场管理层应复核员工应急联络与医疗保障。追踪指标：运营商复产公告、装运计划调整、承包商人员安排。

en.title: Saudi Arabia: Jazan refinery partially suspends operations after attack
en.summary: The energy ministry confirmed a fatal incident and temporary partial suspension at the refinery.
en.body: Reuters reported on 26 November that the Saudi energy ministry confirmed a fire, the death of a Nepalese worker and a partial operational suspension following an attack. The Saudi-led coalition attributed the incident to the Houthis. Assessment: repeated energy-sector incidents increase both personnel and delivery risks. Actual supply consequences depend on the extent and duration of the outage. Procurement teams should confirm delivery commitments; site managers should review emergency communications and medical support. Indicators: operator restart notices, shipment revisions and contractor staffing arrangements.
